# third_party

Unmodified copies of the upstream repositories that tk-winmips64 is derived from. They are kept as the reference for the port and for the C++ oracle (`tools/oracle/`). Compiled binaries (`.exe`, `.obj`, `.cod`, `.dat`) were removed.

| Directory | Upstream | Revision | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `winmips64-mcarrick/` | https://github.com/mcarrickscott/WinMIPS64 (Mike Scott) | `515d3469136fa57aac6b0742edb1bc3623a3d18c` | Apache License 2.0 (`winmips64-mcarrick/LICENSE`) |
| `winmips64-andoni/` | https://github.com/AndoniZubimendi/WinMIPS64 (Andoni Zubimendi) | `322bb665ab6d42e5a6b4e57f61ab01b56ad7eeab` | No license file. It is a fork of the Apache-2.0 repository above. |

The exact revision of each copy is also in its `UPSTREAM_COMMIT` file. See `../NOTICE` for the attribution notices.
